prompt: Three distinct Nuxt performance optimization topics (Cloudflare Image Resizing, CI image optimization pipeline, analytics lazy-load)

assertions.name: identifies-sub-topics
assertions.description: Output identifies 3 distinct sub-topics from the discussion

assertions.name: split-proposal
assertions.description: Output proposes splitting into multiple articles (not writing one combined article)

assertions.name: asks-user-confirmation
assertions.description: Output asks user to confirm the plan before writing full content

assertions.name: provides-per-article-outline
assertions.description: Each proposed article has a working title, category, and key sections

assertions.name: no-full-article-without-approval
assertions.description: Does NOT write a full .md article without first getting user approval
